description: This file contains a unit test class for the DateTimeHelperService component in the OrangeHRM project. It verifies various date and time utilities, including date formatting, time zone handling, date comparisons, range calculations, and week boundary computations.

classes.name: DateTimeHelperServiceTest
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the functionality of the DateTimeHelperService class, including date formatting, comparison, range generation, and week boundary calculation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DateTimeHelperService instance before each test.

methods.name: testFormatDateTimeToYmd
methods.description: Tests the formatting of DateTime objects to 'Y-m-d' string format.

methods.name: testFormatDateTimeToTimeString
methods.description: Tests the conversion of DateTime objects to 'H:i' time string format.

methods.name: testIsDatesEqual
methods.description: Verifies the equality comparison of dates, considering time zones and null values.

methods.name: testDateDiffInHours
methods.description: Checks the calculation of difference in hours between two DateTime objects, including fractional hours.

methods.name: testDateRange
methods.description: Ensures the generation of date ranges with optional interval steps.

methods.name: assertDateArray
methods.description: Utility method to assert that an array of DateTime objects matches expected date strings.

methods.name: testGetNow
methods.description: Validates that the getNow() method returns current DateTime with correct timezone and offset.

methods.name: testGetTimezoneByTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Checks that timezone objects are correctly generated from numerical offsets.

methods.name: testGetWeekBoundaryForGivenDate
methods.description: Tests week boundary calculations for various days and week start day indices.
